notes.title: CLOWNCORE ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.notes:
[p][b]First of all, I want to thank everyone who supported BANNED TAPES![/b] Thanks to you, [/p][p]I’m thrilled to finally announce my new project: [b]"CLOWNCORE" [/b]a [b]first-person stealth horror[/b] game where you infiltrate a mysterious and sinister carnival that appears only once every seven years.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45477221/0f6c9028fe202741b94e13e00e7b3d34bdb495ac.png"][/img][/p][p]The game features:
[b]First-person melee combat[/b] with breakable weapons and a stamina system to manage.
[b]Stealth mechanics[/b] hide under carts, inside barrels, or in the shadows using dynamic lighting.
[b]Interactive environments[/b] with various challenges and, most importantly, [b]enemies[/b] that react to your presence, noise, and actions.
And of course… [b]clowns![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is a huge step forward for me, and I truly hope you’ll enjoy the game. [/p][p]If it sounds like your kind of horror, [b]please wishlist it![/b] [/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3654810/CLOWNCORE/?beta=0"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: The game has been released!
notes.notes:
Today, cassettes are available to anyone who wants them. Become the creator of the world's scariest movie, uncover the mystery of the found tapes, immerse yourself in the atmosphere of BANNED TAPES.
Thank you all for your support.
